verdict.rationale: RevenueCat documents scheduled data exports to a cloud storage provider or email (docs-7). Customer purchase and subscription data can also be pulled programmatically through CustomerInfo and the secret-key REST API (docs-3, docs-19), and streamed out via webhooks (docs-16). However, the evidence never says the exports use an open format, never shows that they cover all data (including project and product configuration), and never describes an account-exit path. missing for 10: explicit open export formats (e.g. CSV/Parquet), evidence that exports are complete including configuration, documented offboarding or data-portability guidance, independent corroboration.
